# Receipt

> Your AI coworker that proves what it did. Receipt runs tasks across your SaaS apps and servers, then backs every result with a verifiable receipt.

Receipt runs tasks across your connected SaaS apps and servers in an isolated
sandbox, gates state-changing operations behind org policy, and records every
step as an immutable, cryptographically chained receipt you can replay and
verify independently.

This site is a client-rendered single-page app addressed by hash routes; fetch
https://receipt-website.vercel.app/llms-full.txt for the full text of every page without running
JavaScript.

## Pages

- [Receipt — an AI coworker that proves what it did](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/): Your AI coworker that proves what it did. Receipt runs tasks across your SaaS apps and servers, then backs every result with a verifiable receipt.
- [Use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases): Worked examples across 11 teams.
- [Engineering use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/engineering): The on-call work between the alert and the fix
- [Customer Support use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/customer-support): Tickets answered with the system of record, not a guess
- [Sales use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/sales): A clean CRM and a briefed rep, without the admin hour
- [Marketing & Growth use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/marketing): Numbers reconciled across every channel, with the rows attached
- [Finance & RevOps use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/finance): Close faster, and be able to prove every number in it
- [IT & Security use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/it-security): Access reviews, offboarding, and evidence that holds up
- [Data & Analytics use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/data-analytics): Pipelines that heal, and metrics you can defend
- [Product use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/product): Evidence for the roadmap, gathered continuously
- [People & HR use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/people): Onboarding, reviews, and the paperwork behind both
- [Founders & Leadership use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/founders): The company's real numbers, without asking four people
- [Legal & Compliance use cases](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/use-cases/legal-compliance): Contract review and obligations that get tracked
- [Integrations](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/integrations): 1,000+ connectors across 14 categories.
- [Pricing](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/pricing): Credit-based pricing from $50; free tier and enterprise plans.
- [Security](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/security): Sandbox isolation, policy gates, and the receipt chain.
- [Blog](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/blog): What we are learning about running AI agents against production systems — the architecture, the failure modes, and the things that turned out to matter more than we expected.
- [Research](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/research): Kentron AI exists because probabilistic systems need deterministic accountability. These are the papers, benchmarks, and design notes we keep coming back to — including our own.
- [Case studies](https://receipt-website.vercel.app/#/case-studies): Anonymised, because the interesting part is the shape of the deployment — what they connected, what they gated, and what changed by the second month.

## Documentation

- [Product documentation](https://docs.kentron.ai/introduction): quickstart, core concepts, and the API.

## Key facts

- Connectors: 1,000+ in the catalog across 14 categories, connectable today.
- Teams with worked use cases: Engineering, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing & Growth, Finance & RevOps, IT & Security, Data & Analytics, Product, People & HR, Founders & Leadership, Legal & Compliance.
- Every action produces a receipt: command, evidence artifact, exit code, chained hash.
- Credentials stay with the connector layer (Nango); Receipt stores encrypted references only.
